annotations.title: Regenerate a section, extend or make a similar track

description: Makes a NEW version of a track from an existing version (spends credits: refused until the user approved the cost, see approve_spending). origin=repaint regenerates only the section [start, end] seconds (at least 3 s) and keeps the rest; origin=extend adds `seconds` of new music after the end, in the same mood (the final length must fit the user's plan); origin=cover makes a similar track from this one (closeness: close, medium or loose). `note` says what should change and is added to the end of the source prompt as written, so write it in English tags. Lyrics, tempo and key come from the source version. Charges the generated seconds (the section, the tail; cover charges the whole track) at the version's quality level. Same response as generate_music.

auto_choose.description: true (default): if the event has no chosen version yet, the new one becomes chosen, so the game plays it. false leaves the choice to the user.

closeness.description: cover: how close to the source (default medium).

end.description: repaint: end of the section, in seconds (at least 3 s after start).

note.description: What should change, added to the source prompt as is (English tags).

origin.description: repaint: regenerates only the section from start to end; extend: adds `seconds` of music after the end; cover: makes a similar track.

quality.description: Quality level; omitted: the track's current level.

seconds.description: extend: how many seconds to add (3 to 90; more, in steps). The final length must fit the plan: up to 4 min for this account.

start.description: repaint: start of the section, in seconds.

version_id.description: The source version (a generationId of a track from generate_music, get_entity or find_sounds).

wait.description: false = only queues it and returns the jobId for job_status (see generate_music).
